behavioral_clauses.controller.barrier_gating: The controller cannot advance until the current action's declared barrier outcome is supplied.
behavioral_clauses.controller.seed: The AnySystem seed and canonical scenario parameters determine one replayable logical plan.
behavioral_clauses.controller.transitions: The controller emits only declared actions in declared logical order.
behavioral_clauses.dagger.execution: Dagger executes the exact controller command and preserves scenario IDs, seed, parameters, and order.
behavioral_clauses.deployment.components: The real deployed components exactly match the registered scenario component set.
behavioral_clauses.deployment.namespace: The run uses a unique non-production chaos-safe namespace and exact run identity.
behavioral_clauses.deployment.revisions: Source, images, manifests, schema, dependencies, Dagger, Litmus, and AnySystem revisions are recorded.
behavioral_clauses.initial_state.fixture: Every material fixture entity and initial observation is present before controlled actions begin.
behavioral_clauses.observations.completeness: Every observation required by consuming oracles is present and bound to exact entities.
behavioral_clauses.observations.no_business_answers: Scenario outputs contain facts and never derived expected business answers or pass/fail fields.
behavioral_clauses.observations.provenance: Every exported fact has one allowed provenance class and source reference.
behavioral_clauses.prerequisite.negative_control: The prerequisite witness remains false when any critical declared component is absent.
behavioral_clauses.prerequisite.witness: The structured prerequisite witness is true only after every declared condition and exact entity is observed.
behavioral_clauses.recovery.condition: all contenders finish and wallet row locks are released.
behavioral_clauses.reset.isolation: Scenario-owned Kubernetes, broker, database, controller, and evidence state cannot bleed into another run.
behavioral_clauses.termination.condition: Completion is emitted only after observations and scoped cleanup barriers succeed.
behavioral_clauses.time.logical_ticks: Controller logical ticks order phases and never claim to control physical infrastructure time.
behavioral_clauses.time.physical: Wall-clock durations are recorded as physical observations and do not choose controller transitions.
behavioral_clauses.workload.identity: Every workload action carries exact scenario, request, actor, and entity identities.
behavioral_clauses.workload.phase: The identified workload begins only in the declared scenario phase and targets the registered deployment.

blocker: The real settlement path has no wallet pre-mutation race barrier.

prerequisite_witness.activation_condition: all contenders report arrival before the same wallet mutation boundary
prerequisite_witness.independent_condition: independent PostgreSQL lock/activity probe identifies every contender
